build_compose_hydra_configuration: build a Hydra configuration by composing overrides with VISSL defaults
create_sweep_hydra_overrides: create a SweepHydraOverrides object that separates CLI overrides into sweep and non-sweep parameters
convert_to_attrdict: convert a Hydra DictConfig to an AttrDict with merged command-line overrides and inferred values
run_infer_learning_rate: run learning rate inference with automatic linear or sqrt scaling based on batch size
run_infer_losses_config: run loss configuration inference to set world size, batch size, and queue parameters for SSL losses
